name: Antidote Ingredients

start.dialog: The Mire is sssick. Many poisoned. I make antidote... but need ingredientsss. Ssspecial moss. Glows at night. Grows on dead treesss. Bring me enough for ten dosesss?
start.objective: Collect glowing night moss from dead trees in the Mire

progress.dialog: The antidote... it takesss time. Need more mossss. Many are sssick.

complete.dialog: Yesss! This will sssave many! You have kindnesss in your heart. Here - cobra antidote ring. Protects you from mosst venomsss. Use welll.

party_comments.kade: A cobra healer. Never thought I'd see that.
party_comments.renna: Venomous creatures often have medicinal properties. Logical.

hidden_outcome: If you bring extra moss for 20 doses, Cobra gives you 'Venom Mastery' - the ability to extract antidotes from any poisonous creature
